text:
An oil tank has a base of area 2.5m2 and is filled with oil to a depth of 1.2m.
The density of the oil is 800kg/m3.
What is the force exerted on the base of the tank due to the oil?
A
960N
B
2400N
C
9600N
D
24000N
subject: Physics
